#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/tmp/openwebide-editor-tools:/tmp/openwebide-editor-tools/binaryen-version_131/bin:$PATH
export CHROMEDRIVER=/tmp/openwebide-editor-tools/chromedriver
export CHROME='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome'
export WASM_BINDGEN_TEST_TIMEOUT=300
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy -p openwebide-storage -p openwebide-core -p openwebide-auth -p openwebide-agent -p openwebide-llm --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p openwebide-backend --target wasm32-wasip2 -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p openwebide-frontend --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p openwebide-bridge --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test -p openwebide-storage -p openwebide-core -p openwebide-auth -p openwebide-agent -p openwebide-llm -p openwebide-bridge -p openwebide-backend
cargo test -p openwebide-frontend --lib
cargo test -p openwebide-core --features editor-parser --lib
cargo test -p openwebide-frontend --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- --skip 'editor::'
python3 tools/run-editor-browser-tests.py
cargo clippy -p openwebide-editor-bench --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test -p openwebide-editor-bench --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib
NO_COLOR=true spin build
